title: Sign encoding of the proof table
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean table indexed by $2^n+2^{n^2}$ indices, the function on the binary cube obtained by restricting that table to its first $2^n$ indices and converting its values to signs is pointwise equal to the sign encoding of the function obtained by the same restriction followed by conversion to $[?]$ the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean table indexed by $2^n+2^{n^2}$ indices
caveat: The conclusion uses the stipulated equivalences between binary cube points, table indices, Boolean values, and field elements; their informal descriptions are absent from the supplied definitions.
